should_trigger.prompt: Write a 3-email welcome sequence for new customers of a sustainable fashion brand.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Skill triggers for lifecycle email. Applies the brand card's voice (run /brand first), brand story → fabric proof → first-customer offer arc. Includes subject variants and timing.

should_trigger.prompt: Write a cold outreach email to a boutique retailer about stocking our fashion line.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Cold outbound section activates. Peer-level voice, observation → problem → proof → ask structure, interest-based CTA. No feature dumps, no 'I hope this email finds you well'.

should_trigger.prompt: Write a cart abandonment sequence for a tools retailer — 3 emails.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Lifecycle map for the cart-abandon flow applies: 2-3 emails ('you left a [product]' → 'still available, but limited'). Brand voice from the brand card. One CTA per email.

should_trigger.prompt: Write this month's newsletter for a sustainable fashion brand — focus on a new fabric deep dive.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Broadcast type identified. Newsletter cadence from the brand's lifecycle map or brand card. Plain text preferred. Subject: curiosity > clarity for newsletters. ≤40 chars.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Write the copy for a SaaS product landing page.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Landing page / sales page copy routes to /writing copy, not /writing email. The email specialist is for email-channel work only.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Improve the in-product onboarding tooltip copy and empty state messages in our SaaS app.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: In-product onboarding flows (tooltips, empty states, in-app microcopy) route to /marketing (CRO), not /writing email. The email specialist covers the email channel only.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Write a long-form newsletter essay about the future of sustainable fashion — 2000 words.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Long-form non-funnel content (essays, thought leadership not tied to a sequence) routes to /writing or /writing blog, not /writing email.

output_quality.prompt: Write a win-back email for a 60-day lapsed customer with two CTAs: browse new arrivals and get a discount.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Skill enforces one CTA per email rule (exception is post-purchase confirm). Should pick one CTA and explain why, or propose two separate emails.

output_quality.prompt: Write a cold email that starts: 'Hi [Name], I hope this email finds you well. My name is the approving human and I work at a fashion brand. We are a leading provider of sustainable fashion.'
output_quality.expected_behavior: Skill must rewrite this: strips 'I hope this email finds you well', 'My name is X', 'leading provider'. Rewrite leads with their world, peer-level voice, specific observation.

output_quality.prompt: Write subject lines for a restock alert email from a tools retailer.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Subject lines ≤40 chars, no all-caps, no emoji unless the brand card allows it, clarity > curiosity for transactional. 3 variants provided.

safety.prompt: Write a win-back email that opens with a 20% discount to get lapsed customers back.
safety.expected_behavior: Skill flags discount as opener as an anti-pattern (kills LTV) and proposes a story/arrival/value opener with the discount as a secondary element if used at all.

safety.prompt: Write a nurture email sequence as full HTML with a hero image and 3 feature graphics.
safety.expected_behavior: Skill flags HTML bloat and images-only as a deliverability risk. Recommends plain text for nurture. Plain text > HTML for nurture (deliverability + trust) is a body rule.

pressure.prompt: Write a follow-up email that says 'Just checking in to see if you had a chance to look at my previous email.'
pressure.expected_behavior: 'Just checking in' is a documented anti-pattern. Skill must rewrite with a new angle, fresh proof, or a useful resource. Explains why the original is an anti-pattern.

pressure.prompt: Write 10 follow-up emails for cold outreach, sending one every 2 days.
pressure.expected_behavior: Skill should cap at 3-5 touch sequence with increasing gaps, not a 10-email daily barrage. Flags deliverability and relationship risk of aggressive cadence.

compatibility.prompt: Write cold-email B2B prospecting emails for a SaaS product.
compatibility.expected_behavior: Cold outbound lives in this email specialist's cold-outbound section and is handled directly here.

compatibility.prompt: Set up a 6-email nurture drip sequence with branching logic for a fashion brand.
compatibility.expected_behavior: Complex multi-email sequences load references/sequence/reference.md per the routing section. Skill does not attempt to handle complex sequence architecture from the router file alone.
